## Ingredients and instructions 

Green goddess dressing: 

- 1/2 c Mayo 
- 1 tsp basil 
- Heavy 1 tsp dill
- 3/4 tsp parsley
- 19 g spinach 6 g spinach (or could do 6g parsley instead)
- 1 clove garlic smashed and thrown in 
- 3 g salt 
- 1/4 TBS honey 
- Pulse blend with immersion blender 
- Juice of 1/4 lemon 
- 1/2 avocado 
- 5 g chives (1 tablespoon) 

Add half of the green goddess dressing save the other half for other stuff

Mix it all up (fold it gently together)
Serve on toast or with a salad or however for a vibrant green goddess egg salad. The original recipe served on a croissant and boy if I find a gf croissant I'm 100% trying that.
